system.name: Industrial Edge Gateway
system.description: Acquires OPC UA and MQTT signals from CNC machines, robots, and PLCs, normalizes measurements, and publishes telemetry to Kafka.

roleInArchitecture.summary: Acquires OPC UA and MQTT signals from CNC machines, robots, and PLCs, normalizes measurements, and publishes telemetry to Kafka.
mainResponsibilities: Acquire OPC UA and MQTT machine signals
Normalize equipment identifiers, timestamps, units, and quality flags
Buffer and publish normalized telemetry during intermittent plant connectivity

risks.description: Unsynchronized equipment clocks can corrupt production-cycle ordering and anomaly windows.
A prolonged Kafka outage can exhaust the gateway buffer and create telemetry gaps.
